assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: concept-only environment illustration for SIGNAL / 47, a low-poly Three.js first-person investigation game. Final composition 16:9 landscape, 1920x1080.
Input image: reference image only. The supplied real game screenshot establishes the small room scale, painted concrete-block walls, wet bench, bottle shelves, shallow developing trays, overhead drying line and strong red safelight. It is not an edit target; create a fresh composition rather than copying the screenshot.
Primary request: an empty compact photographic darkroom at a New Mexico observatory in 1986, viewed at standing first-person eye height from the doorway toward the processing bench. Clearly stylized low-poly game environment with simple box-built geometry, a few facets, clean readable shapes, restrained hand-painted texture wear and matte practical materials. An L-shaped worn grey workbench, three shallow developing trays, a modest enlarger, plain chemical bottles without labels, a basin and a simple drying line holding a few small blank photographic papers. The room is functional, mundane and a little tired.
Lighting and palette: saturated deep red safelight from one small wall fixture, dim red bounce sufficient to read the entire work area, dark neutral shadows, no white overhead lamp and no blue light leaking in. Matte pale concrete blocks take on a red hue; dull metal and old laminate, no glossy futuristic materials.
Composition: wide immersive room interior, bench and trays as the main focus, open center floor, plausible compact scale, good separation of equipment silhouettes, no cinematic letterboxing. A polished but achievable stylized Three.js visual direction, intentionally simple enough for mobile low-poly production, not a photograph and not photorealistic.
Avoid: people, UI, crosshair, menus, captions, watermarks, readable text of any kind, lettering or numbers, brands, logos, room numbers, chapter numbers, alien motifs, supernatural props, new lore, excessive clutter, dramatic fog, film grain or lens blur. This is concept art only, not evidence of implemented gameplay.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: concept-only environment illustration for SIGNAL / 47, a low-poly Three.js first-person investigation game. Wide 16:9 landscape composition, final target 1920x1080.
Input image: reference image only for the New Mexico 1986 motel era, warm bedside lamp versus blue desert night, plain wooden furniture and worn turquoise-painted trim. Do NOT copy its composition, person, paper evidence, captions, photorealistic rendering or room number. Create an entirely new empty room view in a clearly simpler low-poly style.
Primary request: an ordinary, slightly worn roadside motel room at night in New Mexico, 1986. View from just inside the entrance looking diagonally across the compact room. One modest bed with a simple muted ochre/rust geometric bedspread and wooden headboard, a small bedside table with one warm amber shaded lamp, a boxy 1980s wood-veneer CRT television switched off on a low dresser, a little plain round ashtray on an uncluttered cheap table, and a closed unattended worn brown travel suitcase resting near the bed. A simple closed entrance door with no numbers or lettering and a curtained window showing quiet deep-blue night and a small strip of sparse desert beyond. Empty, mundane, believable lodging; quiet absence rather than overt horror.
Style: clearly stylized low-poly Three.js game concept, simple angular geometry, broad flat material regions, restrained hand-painted wear, low polygon rounded objects with visible planar faces, matte wood and fabric. Attractive, legible shapes realistically achievable in a modest browser game. Do not produce a photograph, cinematic realism or a highly detailed interior render.
Lighting and palette: soft warm amber from the one bedside table lamp, deep navy blue night through the window, muted dusty ochre, faded teal trim and warm brown wood. Keep the bed, CRT television, ashtray and suitcase visibly recognizable without excessive dramatic darkness. No glossy sci-fi materials, no atmospheric fog, no depth-of-field blur, no film grain.
Constraints: no people, no faces, no characters, no writing, text, numbers, room number, chapter titles, logos, captions, watermark, UI or letterbox border. No new story clues, photographs, evidence documents, paranormal motifs, crime scene or visible weapons. The unresolved room number must not appear anywhere. This image is a speculative environment concept only, not evidence of an implemented game scene.
